I looked at both. The heart in B works fine — click it and it fills in to show the pasta recipe is marked — but on its own a heart reads more like a "favorite" or "love it" to me than "come back and read this later." Prototype A's little button that spells out "Read later" and flips to "Saved for later" leaves no doubt about what it means.

So I'd rather use A, the labeled text control. Clarity matters more to me here than the compactness of an icon.
